fontes.ohrm: United Nations, Office of Human Resources Management. Competency-based Interviewing Guide (modelo 'UN Competencies for the Future', 1999).
fontes.unhcr: UNHCR. Best Practice Interview Guide for Interviewers: Skills and processes (quadro de competências do PAMS, 2008).

pos: Upholds the principles of the United Nations Charter.
Demonstrates the values of the United Nations, including impartiality, fairness, honesty and truthfulness, in daily activities and behaviours.
Acts without consideration of personal gain.
Resists undue political pressure in decision-making.
Does not abuse power or authority.
Stands by decisions that are in the Organization's interest even if they are unpopular.
Takes prompt action in cases of unprofessional or unethical behaviour.
neg: Interprets principles and ethics flexibly without justification.
Seeks personal gain.
Compromises too readily when under pressure.
Favours certain issues, individuals or groups in a subjective way.
Is not reliable.
May be dishonest.

perguntas.q: Tell me about the last time that you were faced with a professional or ethical dilemma at work (in the recent past).
probes: What was the specific situation?
How did you feel?
How did you resolve the dilemma?

perguntas.q: When have you been asked to ‘bend the rules’ by a colleague or client?
probes: How did you manage the situation?
What pressures were you under?
What factors did you have to consider?
What was the outcome?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you have had to choose between admitting a mistake and maintaining credibility to a superior or client.
probes: What did you do?
How did you decide what to do?
How does your approach compare to colleagues (others) who have faced this situation?
What would you do differently next time?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time you have observed others working in an unprofessional or unethical manner.
probes: What was unprofessional or unethical about their behaviour?
What did you specifically do about their behaviour?
What were the implications of taking action?
How did you deal with the possible consequences?
How likely are you to take action compared with your colleagues?

perguntas.q: In most organizations there are rules, regulations and principles that have to be adhered to and some that can be interpreted more flexibly. Give me an example of a time where you have interpreted the rules with more flexibility.
probes: What was the specific situation?
What made the situation ambiguous?
What did you do well in handling the situation?
What else could have you done?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you have had to defend an organization’s decision to others who did not agree with the viewpoint.
probes: What was the specific situation?
Why did you defend the decision?
What did you say or do that was particularly effective?
In hindsight, what would have you done differently?

unhcr.def: Demonstrates the highest level of commitment to and respect for persons of concern to UNHCR, partners and colleagues in all aspects of work and ensures that personal professional behaviour is of the highest standard.

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you faced a professional or ethical dilemma at work.
probes: What was the specific situation?
How did you feel?
How did you resolve the dilemma?

perguntas.q: Please give an example of when you had to defend an organizational decision to others who did not agree with the viewpoint.
probes: What was the specific situation?
Why did you defend the situation?
What did you say/do that was particularly effective?
What might you have done differently?

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when you observed others working in an unprofessional/unethical manner.
probes: What was unprofessional or unethical about their behaviour?
What did you specifically do about their behaviour?
What were the implications of taking action?
How did you deal with the possible consequences?
How likely are you to take action compared with your colleagues?

pos: Shows pride in work and in achievements.
Demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter.
Is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results.
Is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns.
Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges.
Remains calm in stressful situations.
neg: Is less motivated than others to achieve.
Appears less knowledgeable to others about subject matter or field.
Is complacent about achievements.
Sets easy targets and personal objectives.
Allows pressure to get to him/her.
Tends to find it hard to bounce back after setbacks and difficult challenges.

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when it has been important for you to appear knowledgeable about your area of specialty.
probes: Why was this so important?
How did you go about establishing credibility?
When has your approach been less successful?
What would you do differently?
To what extent are you considered to be competent in your field?
How do you know this?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you have experienced a setback.
probes: Describe what happened.
How did you react to the problem?
To what extent did others see how you were feeling?

perguntas.q: How do you define success in your current role/previous work?
probes: Can you give me a specific example of when this has occurred?
What specifically do you wish to achieve?
How do you know when you have achieved success?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you have set yourself an ambitious target.
probes: What made it so ambitious?
How did it compare with other targets you had set yourself?
How well did you do?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you worked especially hard in your current role/work?
probes: Which aspect of the situation motivated you to work hard?
Which aspect of the situation demotivated you?
What feedback did you have on your performance?
What kinds of professional concerns motivate you?

unhcr.def: Behaves in a way which is appropriate to a UNHCR staff member, demonstrating self-control, perseverance, and resilience in the face of pressure or adversity, and demonstrating knowledge on relevant subject matter and skills.

perguntas.q: Tell us about a project where you achieved success despite some obstacles making it difficult for you to proceed as planned.
probes: What was the goal of the project?
What were the challenges you had to overcome?
What specifically did you do to ensure you were successful?
Would you do anything differently another time?

perguntas.q: Describe a situation where you had to work under pressure.
probes: What was the reason for the pressure?
How did you deal with it?
What was the outcome?
What did you learn from this?

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when you were successful in getting one of your ideas acted upon despite strong opposition.
probes: What made you successful?
Why was there opposition?
Professionalism can also be used as a Competency to reflect a particular expertise needed for a position
Why was it important for you to get this idea accepted?
Is there anything you would do differently another time?

pos: Works effectively with people from all backgrounds.
Treats all people with dignity and respect.
Shows respect for, and understanding of, diverse points of view and demonstrates this understanding in daily work and decision-making.
Examines own biases and behaviours to avoid stereotypical responses.
Does not discriminate against any individual or group.
neg: Is unable to relate to people from other backgrounds.
Is insensitive to the needs of individuals with different perspectives.
May offend people from different background.
Is unable to view issues from the perspective of people with diverse viewpoints.

perguntas.q: What experience have you had with working with people from diverse backgrounds?
probes: Describe a specific situation where you have had to relate to others from a different background from yours?
How could you improve how you interact with people from different backgrounds?
Based upon your experience, what advice would you give to someone having difficulty working with people from different backgrounds.

perguntas.q: Describe an occasion when you found it difficult to work with someone from a different background.
probes: What caused the problems?
How did you respond?
What was the outcome?
What would you do differently next time?

perguntas.q: Describe a situation that required you to consider a different perspective from your own when exploring an issue.
probes: What did you learn from the experience?
How do you think you could improve your ability to see issues from a different perspective?
How do you rate your ability in relation to your peers?
What do you see as being the key to effectively viewing issues from an alternative perspective?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of a situation where you have pursued a course of action which had to take into account the sensitivities of external (different) parties.
probes: What were the issues?
What did you specifically do to handle these?
What was the outcome?

perguntas.q: What opportunity have you had to examine your own biases and behaviours when dealing with people?
probes: What observations have you made?
Describe an example of when you have attempted to avoid a stereotypical response.
What did you do that was effective?
What feedback did you get from the person/people?
How could you be more effective in this area?

perguntas.q: When you are liaising with colleagues or others from different cultures, what sorts of issues do you need to take into account?
probes: When did this knowledge help you to get your job done more efficiently?
When did you overlook something?
How did you handle this?

unhcr.def: Shows respect for all persons equally without distinction whatsoever of race, gender, religion, national or ethnic origin, language, marital status, sexual orientation, age, socio-economic status, disability, political conviction, or any other distinguishing feature (e.g. HIV status).

perguntas.q: Give an example of a situation in which your work entailed bringing together people from a wide range of backgrounds and ideas.
probes: Why was this important?
What was your method for encouraging/ensuring this collaboration?
What was the outcome?
Would you do anything differently another time?

perguntas.q: Describe a situation that required you to consider a different perspective to your own when exploring an issue.
probes: What did you learn from the experience?
How do you think you could improve your ability to see issues from a different perspective?
How do you rate your ability relative to your peers?
What do you see as key to effectively viewing issues from an alternative perspective?

perguntas.q: Please tell us about a situation in which you pursued a course of action which had to take into consideration the sensitivities of external parties.
probes: What were the issues?
What did you specifically do to handle the situation?
What was the outcome?

pos: Speaks and writes clearly and effectively.
Listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately.
Asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication.
Tailors language, tone, style and format to match the audience.
Demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.
neg: Lacks confidence when talking.
Produces writing that is vague or wordy.
Uses inappropriate language.
Tends to stick to one style of communication.
Lacks expression during the interview.
Loses the attention of the reader/audience at times.
Tends to drift from one topic to another.
Limited positive feedback from others on communication effectiveness.
Withholds information without sufficient justification.

perguntas.q: How would other people describe your communication skills?
probes: What positive things have people said about your ability to communicate with others?
What development areas have been highlighted for you (e.g., speaking skills, listening skills)?
Compared to others, how would you rate yourself as a communicator? Why?
What could you do to become better at communicating with others?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you had to explain something difficult to someone who did not have your background/knowledge.
probes: What information did you need to get across?
What did you consider when explaining the concept?
What was the most difficult aspect about giving the explanation?
How did you ensure that they understood?
What would you do differently next time?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when it was important to involve someone in a conversation.
probes: Why was it important to involve them?
How did you go about involving them?
When has your approach been less effective?
In retrospect, what would have you done differently?

perguntas.q: What kind of correspondence have you had to prepare in the past?
probes: What experience have you had in writing formal communication?
How effective is your writing technique?
How could you improve the quality of your writing?

perguntas.q: What experience have you had speaking formally in front of others?
probes: Describe a talk or presentation which you have given recently.
How did you tailor the discussion to suit the audience?
How did the audience react?
What feedback did you receive?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you have chosen not to disclose information to others.
probes: What was the situation?
When are you less likely to share information with others?
What are the main issues you consider when deciding whether to share information with others?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you have outlined the key points in an argument in the past.
probes: What did you do specifically that was effective?
How could you presented your argument more effectively?
In what situations have you been least effective at outlining your arguments to others?
How would you rate your skills at outlining an argument orally as compared with your peers?
What do you see as being the key to successfully putting an argument across orally?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of a situation when it was important for you to communicate a strategy or organizational objective clearly to others.
probes: Why was it important?
What did you do to prepare your communication?
What did you do that was particularly effective?
What factors did you feel were important to address?
How did you make sure you were understood?

unhcr.def: Is sensitive, compelling and clear in formal and informal communication, which encourage engagement and contribution to improved outcomes for all the involved stakeholders. Demonstrates behavioural flexibility in engaging colleagues, partners and persons of concern of different cultural backgrounds, gender, or with different objectives; has well developed listening skills; explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way

niveis.L2: Engages in daily communication with peers and immediate work colleagues successfully
niveis.L3: Pursues open channels of communication with other teams and relevant partners, and actively promotes ideas and manages information flow.
niveis.L4: Identifies and shapes the area of responsibility’s message to internal and external partners; implements communication strategy

perguntas.q: Tell us about a situation where your communication skills made a difference to a situation?
probes: What was the situation?
How did you make that difference?
What specific techniques did you use?
What feedback did you get on your effort?

perguntas.q: Please describe a situation where you had to explain something complex to a colleague or client.
probes: What was complex about the situation?
Which problems did you encounter?
How did you deal with them?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you had to adapt your communication approach to suit the group you were addressing.
probes: Who were you addressing?
Why was it important to adapt your approach?
How did you ensure you were understand?

perguntas.q: Please give us an example of where your listening skills proved crucial to an outcome.
probes: Why was it important?
What did you do to make a difference to the outcome?
What do you consider the main elements of effective listening?

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when you were asked to summarise complex points.
probes: What were the circumstances where this was necessary?
What did you do to ensure your summary was accurate?
How did you verify this?

perguntas.q: Please tell us about a situation where it was important for you to show empathy?
probes: What was the situation?
Why was this so important?
What did you do to ensure the other party understood?

perguntas.q: Please give an example of when it was important for you to clearly communicate an organizational objective.
probes: Why was it important?
What factors did you feel were important to address?
How did you make sure you were understood?
What was the outcome?

perguntas.q: Please give an example of where one of your reports was negatively received.
probes: Why was this?
From whom did the criticism come?
Did you feel it was justified?
What did you do as a result of this?

pos: Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organisational goals.
Solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others.
Places team agenda before personal agenda.
Builds consensus for task purpose and direction with team members.
Supports and acts in accordance with final group decisions, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position.
Shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.
neg: Rarely offers support to colleagues.
Prefers to work alone.
Emphasizes achieving personal goals.
Shows limited consideration of the ideas and input of others.
Prefers to act alone.
Is prepared to ignore/disrupt majority decisions.
Takes the credit for team accomplishments; passes on responsibility for team limitations.

perguntas.q: Tell me about the last time you worked as part of a team.
probes: What was the purpose of the team?
What did you like about working in the group?
What did you dislike?
How did you get the team members to cooperate?

perguntas.q: When have your personal objectives been at odds with those of the team?
probes: How did you react?
What was the outcome?
How do you balance competing personal and team goals?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you worked in a really effective team.
probes: What made the team so effective?
What was your particular contribution to the team?
How did your colleagues relate to you?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you had to support others in a team.
probes: Why did they need support?
What did you do to support them?
How did that change things?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you have accepted joint responsibility for a team’s limitations or problems.
probes: What was the situation?
How did you explain about your part in the situation?
What would you do differently next time?

perguntas.q: Describe an occasion when you had difficulties working with a team.
probes: What caused the problems?
How did you respond?
What was the outcome?

perguntas.q: Give me a specific example of when you have encouraged a cooperative approach in a team.
probes: What did you do that was particularly effective?
What were the advantages of this approach?
What did not work so well?
How did you ensure that you made the best use of people’s ideas?
How did you go about making decisions in that group situation?

unhcr.def: Demonstrates the ability to work effectively with colleagues and partners from different backgrounds, cultures and functions, to achieve shared goals and optimize results

niveis.L1: Participates in team/unit projects, performs assigned work
niveis.L2: Engages well with peers and immediate work group to ensure overall team assignments are successful as needed
niveis.L3: Actively promotes a sense of team by one's own actions; ensures staff contributions are recognized
niveis.L4: Works to ensure the best possible environment for collaboration and knowledge sharing, leading by example

perguntas.q: Describe a time where you worked in a highly effective team.
probes: What was the reason for its effectiveness?
What was your role within the team?
What did you contribute towards it being effective
What key elements would you wish to find in any future team you work in?

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when your personal objectives were at odds with those of other members of the team
probes: How did you react?
What was the outcome?
How do you balance competing personal and team goals?

perguntas.q: Give an example of a time when you had to deal with a conflict within a team?
probes: What did you do to resolve the situation?
How did you rebuild rapport within the team?
How did you assess the success of your efforts?

perguntas.q: Please tell us about a time when it was important to build relationships with other members of the team. Why was this important?
probes: How did you approach this task?
What challenges did you face?
What advice would you give others wanting to foster more collaboration in a team?

pos: Takes ownership for all responsibilities and honours commitments.
Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards.
Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules.
Supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments.
Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.
neg: Defers responsibility.
Does not deliver on commitments.
Produces poor-quality work.
Is unaware of standards that need to be achieved.
Takes longer than is efficient to achieve quality.
Compromises standards easily; cuts corners.
Is unconcerned with the standards of other people’s work once it has been delegated.

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when it has been particularly important for you to produce high-quality work.
probes: Why did the work have to be of such a high standard?
How did you ensure that these standards were met?
What would you do to improve the quality of your work?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when time pressures prevented you from spending a lot of time on a task.
probes: What implications did this have for the quality of your work?
How did you ensure that the task was done properly?
What would you do differently in the future?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you did not meet your usual standards of work.
probes: What alerted you to this?
How did you overcome the problem?
What were the long-term consequences?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you failed to complete a task on time.
probes: Why was this?
What steps had you taken to avoid this?
What lessons did you learn?

perguntas.q: Describe a time when you delegated a task to another person.
probes: How did you enable them to carry out the work?
How did you follow up with them?
Who had responsibility for the work?
How was this responsibility established?

perguntas.q: What kinds of regulations or procedures do you have to respect at the moment?
probes: What impact does this have on the way you work?
How well do you manage to keep to them?
What problems do you have adhering to them?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when it was particularly important for you to take responsibility for your actions.
probes: What had you done that you had to take responsibility for your actions?
Why was taking responsibility so important?
How did you make this known to others?

perguntas.q: When, on reflection, were you conscious that your team’s results /output could have been better?
probes: What did you do to address the issue?
How responsible were you for the team’s results/output?
What was achieved?
What feedback did you have on the subsequent performance of the team?

unhcr.def: Assumes responsibility for the delivery of high quality outcomes, in both good and bad times, upholding the values and principles of UNHCR; demonstrates the ability and drive to maintain focus on positive outcomes for persons of concern despite difficulties this may pose for self and team. Demonstrates security awareness.

niveis.L1: Sees tasks through to completion with professional integrity
niveis.L2: Makes decisions appropriate to the position and takes responsibility for professional obligations
niveis.L3: Works to support directly reporting staff in the fulfilment of their responsibilities; monitors delegated tasks; client focus (clients at this level are both internal and external)
niveis.L4: Carries out an effective management of resources under shifting priorities to meet expected results at or above UNHCR standards; external client focus

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when you went against a policy?
probes: Why did you do that?
How did you handle it?
What were the repercussions for you?

perguntas.q: Can you give an example of a time when it was particularly important for you to take responsibility for your actions
probes: What had you done that required this action?
Why was this important?
How did you make this known to others?

pos: Actively seeks to improve programmes or services.
Offers new and different options to solve problems or meet client needs.
Promotes and persuades others to consider new ideas.
Takes calculated risks on new and unusual ideas; thinks "outside the box”.
Takes an interest in new ideas and new ways of doing things.
Is not bound by current thinking or traditional approaches.
neg: Is slow to produce new ideas.
Views problems in a conventional way.
Accepts the status quo.
Problem-solving lacks creativity.
Thinks in a traditional manner.
Is cautious with new approaches.
Produces few alternatives.
Accepts outdated working methods.
Suggestions are not taken up by others.
Little experience of creativity at work.

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you came up with a new idea at work.
probes: Why was this important?
How did you arrive at this idea?
What risks did you consider?
How did you get other people interested in the idea?
What was the outcome?

perguntas.q: Creative ideas may initially seem good but in practice be unusable. How often do you find this?
probes: Tell me about one such situation.
How did you decide that the idea was not practical?
What was the outcome of the situation?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of a time when you used a less conventional approach to your work.
probes: Why was this necessary?
Why do you consider your approach to be different?
How well did it work?

perguntas.q: In what situations are you least creative?
probes: What stops you from being innovative?
How do you manage these situations?
What would help you to handle these situations more effectively?

perguntas.q: Describe a situation when you produced an |imaginative solution to a problem at work.
probes: How did you generate the solution?
What feedback did you receive?
What would you do differently next time?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you questioned a way of working.
probes: Why did you question it?
What alternative did you suggest?
To what extent were your ideas used?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you took a risk with pursuing a new approach or idea.
probes: What was risky about pursuing the approach/idea?
How did you handle the situation?
How far did the new approach/idea progress?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a recent time when you went about instituting improvement and change.
probes: How was it decided that an improvement was needed?
How did you go about making the change(s)?
What resistance was there to the change(s)?
What effect did the changes have?
What feedback did you receive regarding the quality of your idea?
Core  Competencies --

unhcr.def: Challenging established methods and generating/enabling new, innovative solutions, promoting brainstorming, and fostering creativity and reasonable risk-taking. Creating an environment where leaders can emerge

niveis.L1: Demonstrates the ability to develop and implement creative and innovative ideas
niveis.L2: Creates an environment within the work place that encourages innovation, creative ideas
niveis.L3: Fosters risk-taking with ideas and new ways of approaching work in others; openness to new approaches
niveis.L4: Works to find new ways of doing things on an ongoing basis and does so across work relationships within and outside the organisation

perguntas.q: Describe a situation where you created a new approach to an old problem. Why was this necessary?
probes: How did you manage the process?
What reaction did you have from colleagues?
How successful were you?

perguntas.q: Tell us about a time when you had to convince a senior colleague that change was necessary. What made you think that your new approach would better suit the situation?
probes: What skills did you use to approach the issue with your colleague?
What was his/her reaction?
How successful were you?

perguntas.q: Give us an example of when you used a less conventional approach to your work
probes: Why did you consider your approach to be different from the norm?
Why was it necessary?
How well did it work?

pos: Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies.
Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required.
Allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work.
Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning.
Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary.
Uses time efficiently.
neg: Has no clear system of priorities.
Appears disorganized and unsystematic.
Organizes impractical work schedules.
Is unrealistic about timescales.
Efforts get sidetracked.
Deadlines not met.
Tasks not completed.
No checks on activities.
Is unwilling to change plans to meet new demands.

perguntas.q: Tell me how you personally organize yourself when you have a lot of work.
probes: Where do you start?
On what basis did you make your decisions?
What do you do to ensure that it all gets done?
How do you feel inside when you have so much to do?

perguntas.q: Describe an occasion when you had to prepare in advance for a meeting or project.
probes: What did you do?
How much time did you have to prepare?
What could you have prepared better?

perguntas.q: Give me an example of when you had to work to an important deadline.
probes: How manageable were your timescales?
What did you do to ensure that the deadline was met?
How would you organize your activities differently next time?

perguntas.q: Describe the last time you missed a deadline.
probes: Why did this happen?
How responsible were you for this?
What did you do to try to overcome this problem?

perguntas.q: Tell me about the last project plan you had to produce (piece of work or event you had to organize).
probes: What did you do specifically that was effective?
How did you prepare and plan for it?
What timescales did you set?
What could you have done to be more effective in your planning?
How do your planning skills compare with those of your peers?
What are the key stages in project planning as you see them?

perguntas.q: Describe a recent situation where you had to set clearly defined objectives.
probes: How did you go about setting your objectives?
In hindsight, how realistic were your objectives?
What areas do you think you need to work on in terms of your objective setting?
How does your objective-setting compare with that of your colleagues?
What do you see as being the key to setting realistic objectives?

perguntas.q: Thinking of a specific example, how have you gone about helping others with planning their work in the past?
probes: What kind of advice did you give them?
What feedback have you had on your ability to set plans for others?
How do you think your skills in this area compare to your colleagues?
How do you think you could you improve your planning for other people?

perguntas.q: Using a recent example, describe how you have developed actions for achieving an objective.
probes: How useful were your actions when it came to achieving your objectives?
What would you like to improve on in terms of your action planning?
How do your action planning skills compare with those of your colleagues?
What do you think are the key things to remember when developing action plans?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when it was necessary for you to plan several alternative courses of action in response to a change in an organization’s direction.
probes: How did you re-prioritize?
How far did you plan ahead?
How did you monitor the progress of the plans?

perguntas.q: Tell me about a time when you have had to translate a strategy into actions and plans.
probes: What did you specifically do that was effective?
How did you know that your plans were clear enough to be implemented?
How do you break down strategy into manageable tasks?
What would you do differently in hindsight?

perguntas.q: When have you considered strategic issues when developing goals?
probes: Why was this important?
What advice do you give others on strategic implications for goal-setting?
What is the impact of failing to align goals with an organization’s strategy?
How might you address this?
Core   Competencies --

unhcr.def: Able to organize self and others to take efficient and effective action over the short, medium and long term

niveis.L1: Organizes work according to established plans, allocating time and resources
niveis.L2: Demonstrates good organization of time in project management and accomplishing daily tasks
niveis.L3: Carries out planning exercises with the team to identify resources needed early on establishes management tools to monitor plan efficacy
